notes: Indirect-detection search for two-body DM decay to photons (ALP a->gamma gamma) using 285 ks XRISM/Resolve data of the Centaurus cluster. Primary result is a 2-sigma limit on the DM decay rate (qGamma)^-1 vs m_phi (keV), recast into ALP-photon coupling g_phi_gamma_gamma [GeV^-1] in Fig.4 left panel and sterile-neutrino mixing sin^2(2theta) (right panel). Data points here are read/estimated from Fig.4 left panel (double narrow-line XRISM Centaurus limit); values are approximate and jagged due to data fluctuations. One anchor derived from the paper: m_phi=4.6 keV gives lifetime limit -> g~2.1e-17 GeV^-1. Masses converted keV->eV. Not a haloscope, so no local DM density set (NFW profile with rho_s=0.025 GeV/cm^3 cluster, 0.46 GeV/cm^3 MW used internally). Paper also gives sterile-neutrino option (would be a mixing-angle limit, not in enum). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 7))
